$comment: Sound effects of the built-in `dwell` namespace (docs/AUDIO.md). Every sound has a procedural form, and most also recorded `samples` (files in samples/, AUDIO.md §2b) played instead: layers of noise, oscillators and modal partials through filters and envelopes, composed here from a small fixed vocabulary that the client's synth (client/src/audio/synth.ts) understands. Blocks name a sound set with `"sound"` in shared/blocks/*.json. Run `node shared/sounds/gen.mjs` after editing; CI fails if the generated files are stale. The content is prototype (ARCHITECTURE.md §6.1).

brush.$comment: Moving through foliage (tall grass, leaves; AUDIO.md §5 `brush`, BUGS.md #103): on its feet a body rustles only with a footstep, at most one rustle a step; off them (falling, flying, climbing through leaves) one every `everyM` metres moved. Never closer than `minS` seconds either way, and never on entering a cell.

self.$comment: AUDIO.md §5a (BUGS.md #110): where the local player's own sounds are heard (an event's `self`; the game sends them without a position). Each placement is metres from the ear in the listener's own frame — `right`, `up`, `ahead` — so looking up or down never moves them behind the head: footsteps at the feet, a little ahead; a tool at the right hand. `stepM` moves alternate plays (each footstep) that far left and right; `reverb` is the share sent to the room on top of the sound's own. An event without `self` plays centred at the ear (your own voice: a gasp, a hurt).

creatures.$comment: AUDIO.md §2d: each creature model's sounds — a footstep every stride walked, a startle when it breaks into a run, a call now and then (every callEveryS [min, max] seconds) — heard within radiusM.

underwater.$comment: AUDIO.md §3a (BUGS.md #104): with the eye under a fluid's surface every world sound is heard muffled: each listed bus goes through a low-pass at `lowpassHz` (Q `q`) and drops to `gain`, eased over `easeS` at the crossing; open, the filter sits at `openHz` (transparent). The UI and music buses are not listed, so they are never muffled.

ambience.$comment: AUDIO.md §2c: looping beds under the Ambience volume, each at its gain times every condition's ramp over the listener's surroundings; quiet flavour, never above cap.

Look.silent: continuous: a sound per mouse movement would be noise

leaf_brush.$comment: A soft swish layered on a footstep through tall grass or leaves (BUGS.md #103): pink noise only, a slow attack, no grains (the old white-noise grains crackled at five rustles a second); one voice, never restarted.

breath_heavy.$comment: Out of stamina: a person's heavy breath (BUGS.md #159). The pack's MONSTER_Exhausted_05/_07 (a voiced growl that sounded like a bear) were replaced by a man's breath: the pack has no BREATH category, so its one unvoiced in-and-out breath (VOICE_MALE_Sigh_1) and the two breathy exhales of the gasp's and the strain's voice (GRUNT_Male_Quick, _Quick_Deep). The layers (two puffs of noise) play until they decode.
